subject: Console route-level A/B testing — eng plan, staffing, and telemetry dependencies (beta target Mar)
related_links: ADR draft: adr-0188 exposure logging + privacy (Confluence)
body:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 1, 2026 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Console route-level A/B testing — eng plan, staffing, and telemetry dependencies (beta target Mar)

Priya / Marissa — looping Sean + Jonas since the beta gating is going to hinge on guardrails + eval scope.

We did a quick consolidation pass on milestones + resourcing for route-level A/B testing in Console (route-scoped experiments, deterministic assignment, exposure logging, results UI). Wanted to align on two things this week:

1) Platform/Routing staffing + milestone agreement
2) Telemetry dependencies and “no surprises” sequencing (pipeline + dashboards need to land before we expose the UI broadly)

Proposed timeline (high level)
- Phase 0 (this week + next): lock ADRs + API/data contracts, design prototype review
- Phase 1 (Feb): assignment core + exposure events + CRUD UI (dogfood)
- Phase 2 (early Mar): results aggregation + Console dashboards + guardrail alerts + offline eval attachment (beta w/ 2–3 partners)

Key dependencies / “must have” for beta enablement
- Exposure event schema + ingestion: experiment_id + variant + route + project + region + outcome + latency (TTFT + E2E) + token counts + cost attribution hooks.
- Cardinality guardrails: tag allowlist + sampling defaults (so we don’t melt metrics backends with route/model/expt combinations).
- Guardrail evaluator + auto-rollback hook: at least latency p95 regression + error/timeout thresholds with alerting and documented runbook.

Staffing proposal (Console & Tooling)
- Chloe Martin: Console backend CRUD + results query API (ENG-2843/2844)
- Kenji/Tessa (Design): create/validate/start/stop flows, results dashboard layouts
- Leila: end-to-end QA + staged rollout checklist

Where we need Platform/Routing ownership and time boxed support
- Deterministic assignment + precedence rules in policy engine (ENG-2841) + review signoff from Routing/Platform (ADR-0187)
- Gateway emission of exposure events (ENG-2842) + privacy review signoff (ADR-0188)
- Cost attribution dimensioning (Nadia’s area) needs to include experiment_id/variant to make the Console results credible

Asks
- Priya: can you confirm the Platform point person for policy engine changes + exposure emission this month? (Jordan/Mina/Vikram are in the doc, but we need a single DRI for “assignment + exposure.”)
- Sean: can you sanity-check the minimum guardrails you’ll require for beta enablement? (I want to avoid getting to March and hearing “no-go” due to missing alerting/runbook).
- Jonas: confirm eval scope for v1 — I’m assuming “offline suite attachment + summary deltas” only, with online judge sampling explicitly deferred.

If helpful, I can set up a 30 min alignment this Wed/Thu. Marissa is aiming to recruit design partners this month and I want to make sure we’re not overpromising on results quality until telemetry is solid.

Thanks,
Dylan

—
Dylan Brooks
Engineering Lead, Console & Tooling
Redwood Inference



From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 1, 2026 at 10:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: Console route-level A/B testing — eng plan, staffing, and telemetry dependencies (beta target Mar)

Agree with the sequencing and the dependency callouts.

DRI: I’m assigning Jordan Lee as DRI for policy engine + deterministic assignment (ENG-2841) and Amara Diallo as DRI for gateway exposure emission (ENG-2842). They’ll pull in Mina/Vikram as needed for routing concerns, but Jordan/Amara will be accountable.

Two notes:
1) Precedence rules need to be explicit re: canaries/fallbacks. I’m supportive of “reliability wins,” but we need it written down in ADR-0187 and tested.
2) For exposure events: please ensure the schema doesn’t include anything that could be considered user PII. We should assume Security will ask for retention + access rules.

Let’s do the 30 min alignment. I’m open Thu 11:00–11:30 PST.

Priya

—
Priya Natarajan
Platform Sponsor
Redwood Inference



From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 1, 2026 at 11:26 AM PST
Subject: Re: Console route-level A/B testing — eng plan, staffing, and telemetry dependencies (beta target Mar)

On guardrails/beta enablement, minimum bar from SRE:

- A documented “emergency disable / rollback” workflow that Support/Oncall can execute (even if Console UI is partially degraded). Runbook must include verification steps and links to dashboards.
- Alerting that routes to the correct oncall (platform/gateway vs console) with clear ownership.
- Default guardrails: p95 latency regression threshold + error-rate threshold + 429 rate threshold. (We can iterate on exact numbers; the important part is automation hooks exist.)
- A way to stop an experiment quickly without requiring a deploy.

Also: please include exposure volume monitoring. If sampling is misconfigured and exposure logs spike 10x, we need to know quickly.

Happy to review a draft runbook/alert spec async before we wire in automation.

Sean

—
Sean Gallagher
SRE Lead
Redwood Inference



From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 1, 2026 at 1:04 PM PST
Subject: Re: Console route-level A/B testing — eng plan, staffing, and telemetry dependencies (beta target Mar)

Confirming eval scope:

- v1: attach offline eval suite(s) to an experiment and show a summarized delta view per variant (score deltas + confidence guidance).
- out of scope for beta: online judge sampling / human review workflows.

One request: in the Console UI, we should explicitly warn about small sample sizes and avoid implying causality. Even basic “insufficient data” gating will prevent misreads.

Jonas



From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Feb 1, 2026 at 4:38 PM PST
Subject: Re: Console route-level A/B testing — eng plan, staffing, and telemetry dependencies (beta target Mar)

Thanks all.

Dylan — aligned on timeline and that telemetry correctness is a gating item for beta partner confidence.

Action items I’m taking:
- I’ll update the beta partner outreach email to set expectations: results dashboard will include latency/cost/error out of the gate; quality deltas are limited to offline suites in v1.
- I’ll incorporate Sean’s guardrail “minimum bar” into beta enablement criteria (so we’re not debating it late).

Priya — Thu 11:00–11:30 PST works. Dylan, please send an invite and include a quick agenda:
1) ADR-0187 open questions (precedence, retries/streaming)
2) telemetry schema + sampling defaults
3) beta gating checklist

Marissa

—
Marissa Cole
Product Lead, Console & Rollouts
Redwood Inference
